author: opencode-worker-2
text: Worker-2 round finding (released, BLOCKED on the 0.1.3 upgrade actually being consumable): (1) The workspace pins oscore 0.1.2 (rust/Cargo.lock:2645-2647; ~/.cargo has only oscore-0.1.2) — the two-window load_recipient/save_recipient API this bead wires is 0.1.3-only. The parent zlrx (closed) describes the 0.1.3 design, but the crate is not published/available to consume. (2) The bead's premise does not match the code: GatewayOscoreSenderStore has no ContextStateStore implementation and no TODO stubs — the local 0.1.2 SenderStateStore trait has only load/compare_exchange (verified at oscore-0.1.2/src/lib.rs:192-206). (3) The gateway ALREADY persists recipient replay state via GatewayOscoreRecipientStore (sealed 13-byte records + floor files, gateway.rs:258-330) for the GCP path. NEXT STEP (human, per the oscore high-bar rule): publish rust-oscore 0.1.3 upstream (Mark's call), then this bead becomes: bump oscore dep, extend GatewayOscoreSenderStore (or the recipient store) with the two-window methods, reconcile RecipientReplayState (gateway 3-field vs oscore 11-field). Releasing — not actionable by swarm workers until the 0.1.3 crate exists.
